title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Sizing a Monthly Overdraft Replenishment Transfer
content:
The monthly amount of an automatic transfer meant to rebuild a Savings & Money Market Accounts product after overdraft protection draws is fixed by the definition below, once the cycle has been identified.

## Definition

**Overdraft outflow.** The total of every overdraft protection transfer belonging to the cycle, whichever of the customer's checking accounts each one covered.

**Sum to restore.** The overdraft outflow together with the withdrawal fee burden the account carries for the cycle.

**Monthly amount.** The sum to restore, rounded half-up to the cent. Where that sum is below the tier's minimum automatic transfer amount, the monthly amount is raised to that minimum.

**No cycle, no amount.** Where the cycle cannot be identified, no amount is worked out under this policy.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Overdraft outflow | Fees borne | Tier minimum assumed | Monthly amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 180.00 and 95.50, so 275.50 | 20.00 | 75.00 | 295.50 |
| 40.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 75.00, raised to the minimum |
| 60.00 | 45.00 | 75.00 | 105.00 |

## Points of judgement

**One overdraft transfer covered a different checking account of the same owner. Is it left out?** No. The overdraft outflow takes in the cycle's overdraft protection transfers to all of the owner's checking accounts alike.
